cohort: Infants and toddlers from an ongoing three generations cohort study
finding: Children born by Cesarean section have an increased risk of any wheezing and infectious wheezing, but no significant association was found between prenatal antibiotic exposure and wheezing types.
mod_finding: Children born via Cesarean section have approximately a 70-80% increase in the risk of any wheezing and of infectious wheezing.
